migration_notes.title: Insurance enrollment application workflow
migration_notes.summary: Adds an insurance enrollment application workflow with draft, submitted, under-review, accepted, and declined states. Each decision is bound to a specific policy version so that later policy updates cannot retroactively alter an existing decision.
storage_changes: Adds persistent enrollment records keyed by enrollment id, bounded to a fixed maximum number of applications per applicant.
Enrollment records store the bound policy version at decision time.
migration_notes.compatibility: Additive. Existing entry points and storage keys are unchanged; new keys are namespaced under the enrollment prefix.

migration_notes.title: Policy coverage schedule snapshots
migration_notes.summary: Stores immutable coverage and exclusion snapshots at enrollment time so later policy changes cannot silently alter an existing contract.
storage_changes: Adds immutable coverage and exclusion snapshot records written once at enrollment and never mutated.
Snapshot sizes are bounded by a fixed maximum number of coverage and exclusion entries.
migration_notes.compatibility: Additive. Snapshots are written alongside enrollment records; existing policy storage is unchanged.
